author: Ari Koslow
title: Jonathan Isaac waived by Magic
impact: After being the No. 6 overall pick in the 2017 NBA Draft, Isaac was never able to pan out in Orlando, partially due to injuries. He'll look to land a fresh start in free agency.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Kevon Looney expected to have team option declined by Pelicans
desc: The Pelicans are expected to decline Kevon Looney's option for the 2026-27 season.
impact: Looney struggled in his first season with New Orleans. He will likely remain off the fantasy radar wherever he lands.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jaylen Clark returns to Timberwolves on three-year deal
desc: The Wolves are re-signing Jaylen Cark to a three-year deal.
impact: Clark showed enough for Minnesota to want to bring him back. He is unlikely to be on the fantasy radar next season.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Leonard Miller has team option exercised by Bulls
desc: The Bulls have exercised Leonard Miller's option for the 2026-27 season.
impact: After being traded to Chicago, Miller averaged 11.7 points and 5.8 rebounds across 27 games played for the Bulls. He is likely to enter next season in a reserve role.

author: Garrett Ball
title: Ron Harper Jr. to sign a 3-year, $9 million deal
desc: Ron Harper Jr. intends to sign a 3-year, $9 million deal with the Boston Celtics.
impact: Harper had his most involved season as a pro for the Celtics in 2025. After bouncing around from Toronto to Detroit, the forward landed in Boston and played 11 minutes a game, going for 4.2 points, 1.7 rebounds, and 0.8 assists per game in 29 games, including a massive 27 point performance against the Magic in mid April of 2026. He will likely retain his role as a backup and bench unit player.

author: Garrett Ball
title: Isaiah Hartenstein intends to sign 3-year, $75 million deal with OKC
desc: Isaiah Hartenstein intends to sign a 3-year, $75 million deal with the Thunder. OKC will retain one of their key rotation players to add to their embarrassment of riches.
impact: Hartenstein stepped up in the playoffs when Chet Holmgren floundered, and now he is rewarded. The Thunder had cleared up some cap space with the trades they made this week, and this looks like their intended move. The Thunder frontcourt now boasts Holmgren, Hartenstein, and Aday Mara, a truly formidable unit.

author: Diego Sandoval
title: Gary Trent Jr. expected to decline $3.9-million player option
desc: Gary Trent Jr. is expected to decline his $3.9-million player option with the Milwaukee Bucks.
impact: Trent Jr. could be a hot commodity on the open market this offseason for teams in need of a shooter off the bench. The veteran has averaged 38.7% from beyond the arc on 6.1 shots per game in his 8-year career, and put up 8.1 points per game last season with the Bucks.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jose Alvarado returning to Knicks on three-year deal
desc: Jose Alvarado intends to sign a new three-year, $14-plus million deal to return to the Knicks.
impact: Alvarado declined his player option to gain more security. The Knicks made it a priority to retain him following the role he had off the bench in the team's run to a championship.

author: Garrett Ball
title: Isaiah Joe traded to the Detroit Pistons
desc: Isaiah Joe has been traded to the Detroit Pistons for two future second round picks.
impact: Joe brings shooting to a Pistons team that was sorely lacking in three point shooting last year. They were league average in three point percentage, but next to last in threes taken. Joe averaged over 40% from downtown in each of the last four seasons, and should be a great role player addition to the team.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Nikola Topic undergoes surgery, expected to be ready for training camp
desc: Nikola Topic underwent successful spine surgery and is expected for training camp in October.
impact: Topic missed his rookie season with a torn ACL and most of his second season due to testicular cancer treatment.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Chucky Hepburn signs two-way qualifying offer to return to Raptors
desc: Toronto Raptors guard Chucky Hepburn will sign his two-way qualifying offer and return to the team next season.
impact: Hepburn averaged 12.4 points and shot 36.8 percent from deep. He also averaged 8.6 assists and 2.4 steals with the Raptors 905 in the G League. He'll figure to remain in the G League.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Fletcher Loyer signs with Clippers
desc: Purdue's Fletcher Loyer is signing with the LA Clippers.
impact: Loyer scored in double figures during all four seasons in college at Purdue where he had a lot of success. He'll look to prove himself in the Summer League.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Nick Boyd signs with Warriors
desc: Wisconsin's Nick Boyd is signing with the Golden State Warriors.
impact: Boyd is coming off averaging just under 21 points per game in his lone season at Wisconsin. He'll look to prove himself in the Summer League.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Ja Morant expected to be traded
desc: The Grizzlies are expected to move on from Ja Morant this offseason.
impact: ESPN's Brian Windhorst said he "can't see Morant playing for the Grizzlies again." It is unclear what the current trade market is for him. He has two years left on his contract.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Donte DiVincenzo expected to remain with Timberwolves
desc: The Timberwolves are not expected to trade Donte DiVincenzo.
impact: DiVincenzo suffered a ruptured right Achilles tendon in the first round of the playoffs. He is expected to miss most of the upcoming season.
